verdict.rationale: PayPal documents one genuine bulk capability: the Payouts API sends batch payments to multiple, up to thousands, of recipients at once in various currencies. The evidence shows no bulk create, update or cancel for invoices, disputes, subscriptions, products or refunds, and the agent toolkit inventory lists only single-item tools plus list and read tools. Missing for 10: bulk operations beyond payouts (e.g. batch invoice or dispute actions), agent/MCP-exposed batch tools, independent or hands-on corroboration of batch behavior.
